combo.description: Use your Auto attacks on nearby enemies to jump over certain walls in the game. Don't forget to finish with that Q and E combo for some extra burst.
Line up as many AA's on a target as you can, then Q them and E your next target to take them out.
Use your Auto attacks to get closer to your intended target, then Q and E them for some burst!
Q your enemy, AA them and E as you leave the fight.
AA your enemy, then Q, then AA and E them for a quick burst trading combo.
